observations: Photo 0 shows two yellow hydraulic pallet jacks standing upright on a concrete floor.
The jacks have black handles and metal forks with wheels.
The forks appear to be made of metal with some wear and rust, especially on the lower parts.
The jacks are positioned side by side, with one slightly in front of the other.
The background includes a staircase railing, a black bag, and part of a vehicle.
No brand or model markings are visible on the jacks in the photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Heavy duty 2.5 Ton manual hydraulic pallet jack'.
